topic: A Phone Call from a Relative
intro: Your aunt has called. Speak with her politely on the phone.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: The phone is ringing. It is your aunt. Please answer it.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: She asks how your studies are going.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Tell her how your studies are going.
expected: They are going well, thank you.
I am doing well in my studies.
conversation.hint: Try: "My studies are going well, thank you."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Now she is asking whether you will visit in the holidays.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Answer about the holidays, using the future.
expected: Yes, I will visit in the holidays.
Yes, we will visit you soon.
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, I will visit in the holidays."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Ask her something too. It is polite.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask your aunt a polite question.
expected: May I ask how uncle is?

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: She says she must go now. Say goodbye nicely.

conversation.speaker: student
expected: It was nice talking to you. Goodbye.
Give my love to everyone. Goodbye.
